title: Software Metering announcement, a new blog and a clearer pricing page
summary: LicenseMeter now has a blog, and its first post explains Software Metering: what it shows for the Windows apps you deploy through Intune, how setup works, how it protects privacy, and what you need to use it. A banner at the top of the website links to the post. The pricing page now shows Software Metering on the Pro and MSP plans, in its own section with a sample report, in the plan comparison and in the FAQ, in English and German.
